aliases: KLOE pion form factor and muon g-2 contribution

claim.quote: We present the analysis of a new data set corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 240 pb$^{-1}$. We have achieved a reduced systematic uncertainty with respect to previously published KLOE results.

date.locator: arXiv abstract page, submission date (arXiv:0809.3950 v1, 23 September 2008)
date.note: arXiv submission date; published in Phys. Lett. B 670, 285 (2009).

key_value_text.quote: we find $\Delta a^{\pi\pi}_\mu = (387.2\pm0.5_{\rm stat}\pm2.4_{\rm exp}\pm2.3_{\rm th})\times 10^{-10}$

name: Measurement of σ(e+e−→π+π−γ(γ)) and the dipion contribution to the muon anomaly with the KLOE detector
notes: Chosen as KLOE's headline result because hadronic cross sections and the muon anomaly head the physics list in CERN Courier's 2018 summary; KLOE published several later updates of the same measurement.

summary.plain: KLOE measured how often electron-positron collisions at DAΦNE make a pair of pions plus a photon, using photons radiated before the collision, with 240 inverse picobarns of data. From it the collaboration derived the pion's form factor and the two-pion contribution to the muon's anomalous magnetic moment.
summary.technical: KLOE: σ(e⁺e⁻ → π⁺π⁻γ(γ)) with initial-state-radiation photons at small angle, inclusive of final-state radiation, from a new 240 pb⁻¹ data set with reduced systematic uncertainty; pion form factor and Δa_μ^ππ = (387.2 ± 0.5_stat ± 2.4_exp ± 2.3_th) × 10⁻¹⁰ for 0.592 < M_ππ < 0.975 GeV (Phys. Lett. B 670, 285).

title: Measurement of σ(e+e−→π+π−γ(γ)) and the dipion contribution to the muon anomaly with the KLOE detector
why_it_matters: The abstract gives the two-pion contribution to the muon magnetic anomaly obtained from the measured cross section; KLOE's hadronic cross sections are one of the stated physics outputs of the programme (CERN Courier).
